Quarter line (0.75; 1.25; 1.75 etc.) can be settled as won, lost or half won/half lost while the other half of the stake is returned. Half line (0.5; 1.5; 2.5 etc.) can be settled as won or lost. Whole line (1; 2; 3 etc.) can be settled as won, lost or void. For further information please refer to the “How to Play” section.
